rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim involving motor vehicle damage and personal injury sustained in a rear-end accident on Route 9.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am yesterday at a red light. The other vehicle struck at ~35 mph without braking, causing total vehicle loss with trunk crushed into back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. Policy is active auto full coverage with $750 deductible and $100,000 limit. Claim classified as high-severity auto collision.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by another vehicle at approximately 35 mph; other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Car totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injury_party: Claimant injured: whiplash and sprained wrist

rationale: The claim is primarily about damage to the claimant's own vehicle (hood and windshield) caused by a falling tree; this is a covered auto claim involving vehicle damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim (POL-1005, bundle_home_auto, $1,000 deductible, $400,000 limit, active) reported that a maple tree from their own front yard fell during high winds and struck their vehicle parked in the driveway, causing significant damage to the hood and windshield. The tree did not impact the house. Classified as auto claim with medium severity due to structural vehicle damage. No injuries reported. Confidence: 0.95.
